description: This file contains shared UI utility classes and widgets for filter components in a Flutter recipe application. It provides consistent styling for filter chips, an active filters pill, an underline indicator for active filters, and a snackbar for clearing filters with undo support.

classes.name: FilterUi
classes.description: A utility class providing styled filter chips, active filter pill, and underline indicator for filter UI components.

classes.name: ActiveFiltersPill
classes.description: A widget displaying the number of active filters as a stylized pill with animated count changes.

classes.name: FilteredUnderlineBar
classes.description: A subtle animated indicator bar shown under filter chips when filters are active.

classes.name: FilterSnackbars
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to show a snackbar with undo option when filters are cleared.

methods.name: choiceChip
methods.description: Creates a styled Material3 FilterChip with consistent theming, semantics, and animated avatar based on selection state.

methods.name: pickOnTonal
methods.description: Returns a dark color to ensure text readability on tonal fill backgrounds.

methods.name: showFiltersCleared
methods.description: Displays a snackbar indicating filters were cleared with an undo action.
